explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/253 with Cassels's disproof. It is not true that every strictly increasing positive sequence with a_{i+1}/a_i → 1, whose subset sums meet every infinite AP infinitely often, has cofinitely many subset sums. Cassels's counterexample even has subset sums of density 0. 'Every sufficiently large integer' is correctly encoded as membership in the cofinite filter. Formal proof linked.
